title: Meta Buys Conductor, the App That Runs Teams of AI Coding Agents
dek: Conductor Cloud shuts down Nov 20 as the team joins Meta's AI push.

facts.label: Local Mac app winds down early that year

caption:
Meta just bought the startup that turns one coding assistant into a whole team 🤖

Conductor, founded in 2024, built an app that lets developers run several AI coding agents like Claude and Codex side by side, each in its own workspace. Meta confirmed the acquisition but hasn't shared the price. The team, led by CEO Charlie Holtz, will work with Alexandr Wang and Nat Friedman at Meta Superintelligence Labs.

Why it matters: the AI coding race is shifting from single assistants to coordinated agent teams. Meta already launched Muse Code in August, and OpenAI is making similar moves to strengthen Codex.

Using Conductor? Cloud goes read-only Nov 13 and shuts down Nov 20, so export your data now. We're tracking every twist in the AI coding wars at AI Parabellum.
